notes.title: "Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse" Update - 3
notes.content:
[h1]"Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse" Update - 3[/h1]

[b]<Content Additions>[/b]
[list]
[*] Added information (location details) sales at Bunny Shop (Comrade, Tactical Weapon, EB Core Material, Bigfoot Core Material, Equipment Core Material, EB Remains, Bigfoot Remains, Hard Case Remains, Special Fishing Spot, Citadel Special Fishing Spot)
[*] Enhanced visual representation and added firearm accessories for weapons equipped by enemy characters.
[/list]

[b]<Balance Adjustments>[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased rewards for APEX supply drops.
[*] Increased rewards for boss-level monsters.
[*] Improved rewards from indoor collectible objects.
[*] Increased rewards from Olympus monsters.
[*] Storage expansion balance adjusted (Level 6: 140 → 190).
[*] Increased dismantling results for 5th-generation grenade launchers.
[/list]

[b]<QOL Updates>[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an option to separate shooting and interaction keys (Interaction: F key).
[*] Changed dismount/interruption key from F to Z.
[*] Helicopter landing zones now displayed above black fog.
[*] Added a feature to remove all weapon Remodelling Components at once.
[*] Improved oversized icons for enemies and collectible objects in indoor maps.
[*] Bonus values now displayed in resource collection UI for standby personnel.
[*] Adjusted indoor BGM volume to lower when no monsters are present.
[/list]

[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where refrigerators would change position when opened.
[*] Resolved an issue where certain mission progress on the operation board became impossible.
[/list]

notes.title: "Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse" Update - 2
notes.content:
[h1]"Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse" Update - 2[/h1]

[b]< New Content >[/b]
[list]
[*] Warehouse, Bed, and Shooting Range upgrades added up to level 6.
[*] Maximum character level increased to 60.
[*] Certain character skill max levels expanded.
[*] New wandering merchant for TL circuit board exchange (appears after repairing the space shuttle).
[/list]

[b]< Balance Adjustments >[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted health balance for monsters above level 6 (20% reduction at level 10).
[*] Reduced defense stats for some APEX and TL monsters.
[/list]

[b]< Quality of Life Improvements >[/b]
[list]
[*] Emergency exits added to all 2nd and 3rd-floor buildings.
[*] DLC characters now placed on the runway and space shuttle.
[*] Added batch destruction functionality.
[*] Added keyboard controls (keys 1, 2, 3, 4) for character tabs in the bag and skill UI.
[*] Battle armor information added to the full map (only shows repaired units).
[*] Weather information key added to World Mission and Challenge Mode UI.
[*] Adjusted Goliath UI tab order (boarding tab now always appears first).
[/list]

[b]< Bug Fixes >[/b]
[list]
[*] Added exception handling for cases where operations missions were not received due to unconfirmed communications.
[*] Fixed a bug where a level 5 evolved Walker would emerge from a level 12 Wilder egg.
[*] Resolved an issue where the emergency exit popup would reappear even after exiting.
[*] Fixed a bug where disassembling repair tools did not yield materials.
[*] Corrected an issue where 5th-generation grenade launchers could not be disassembled.
[*] Fixed a bug causing teammates to occasionally appear invisible after returning to the base camp while injured.
[*] Fixed a progression bug occurring when the player died immediately after defeating Marcus.
[*] Corrected an issue where modified gun parts sometimes ended up in storage after swapping parts.
[*] Fixed an error where sprint and focus fire functionality would break if injured and returned to the base camp during focus fire.
[/list]

notes.title: "Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse" Update - 1
notes.content:
[h1][b]"Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse" Update - 1[/b][/h1]

[b]<Content Additions>[/b]
[list]
[*] Bunny [Food Exchange] added
[*] Squad Leader gunfire vibration added (+ ON/OFF option)
[/list]

[b]<Balance Adjustments>[/b]
[list]
[*] Quality enhancement general materials decreased by 25%
[*] Item rewards for all level Walker, Runner, and Blaster increased by approximately 20%
[*] Item rewards for all level Trigger and Moss increased by 50%
[*] Increased drop rates for materials and recovery items for level 1–2 monsters
[*] Adjusted low-grade bullet jam rate (1.5% -> 1%)
[*] Increased drop quantity of common bullets by 100%
[*] Adjusted bullet crafting quantity (common bullets +100%, shock and penetrative bullets +50%)
[*] Increased purchase limit and reduced gem consumption for Bunny [Gem Store]
[*] Reduced purchase price and increased purchase limit for general materials in Bunny [Material Exchange]
[*] Reduced material prices sold by the Wandering Merchant by 33%
[*] Simplified 100% completion condition for Wilder Queen area
[*] Adjusted TL circuit board requirement for space shuttle repair cost (1500 -> 800)
[/list]

[b]<Quality of Life Updates>[/b]
[list]
[*] Added emergency exits in large buildings (additional exits planned for 2- and 3-floor buildings)
[*] Revised map colors for large buildings (adjusted visibility in underground)
[*] Added clear indicators on the full map for large buildings
[*] Added check marks on directional arrows within buildings (checked if the area has been looted)
[*] Added building-clear check mark on exit icons in the building mini-map
[*] Added indicators for high and top quality on item icons
[*] Added targeting angle adjustment for gamepad
[*] Added mosquito movement sound ON/OFF option
[*] Added dismantle key in inventory
[*] Adjusted to count hunters appearing in Olympus towards challenge objectives.
[*] Adjusted Tactical Weapon key UI (display all usable Tactical Weapons)
[*] Added help tips when upgrading crafting tools to level 3
[*] Added “Transfer All” function to storage (move the same items together)
[/list]

[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug causing squad members to remain in place during movement animations
[*] Corrected keyboard key description error when selecting a target for recovery items
[*] Corrected English jam rate terminology
[*] Revised Bonnie skill descriptions (fixed missing ally information in languages other than Korean, Japanese, and Chinese)
[*] Fixed bug where gamepad targeting correction did not apply to Bigfoot
[*] Fixed bug where slow status continued after moving to another map after defeating a boss
[*] Fixed bug where emergency transport use while using a teleport portal prevented further portal use
[*] Corrected untranslated text for the number of items to dismantle in gamepad dismantling settings
[/list]

notes.title: "Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse" Update
notes.content:
[h1][b][Balance and Quality of Life Updates][/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Reduce the materials required for equipment crafting by approximately 25% (dismantling results are adjusted accordingly).
[*] Reduce the core materials required for crafting second-generation weapons and armor (dismantling results are also adjusted accordingly).
[*] Increase base movement speed by 10%.
[*] Reduce gathering time by approximately 40%.
[*] Decrease portal cooldown time by approximately 50%.
[*] Increase default inventory slots from 40 to 60.
[*] Significantly enhance the effect of bag inventory slots.
[*] Greatly increase the number of storage slots.
[*] Reduce repair costs for Level 4 Goliath.
[*] Reduce material requirements for upgrading base camp objects (Beds [Levels 1 and 2], Campfire [Repair, Level 1], Storage [Levels 1 and 2], Training Center [Repair, Level 1], Shooting Range [Repair, Level 1], Howitzer [Repair], EB [Repair, Level 1], Bigfoot [Repair, Level 1]).
[*] Reduce the sound of Bigfoot’s footsteps.
[*] Add sound effect for receiving rewards from World Missions and Challenge Mode.
[*] Improve the abrupt darkening effect when night falls.
[*] Improved walking speed and movements in the opening scene
[*] Run Steam Achievements Resync once after update
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix - 3
notes.content:
[b][Balance and Quality of Life Updates][/b]
[list]
[*] Increased base inventory slots from 32 to 40
[*] Increased base storage slots from 15 to 30
[*] Significantly increased maximum durability
[*] All equipment will be fully repaired upon first login after the update due to durability balance adjustments
[*] Increased output of repair tools crafted with scrap iron from 5 to 8
[*] Increased output of repair tools crafted with high-quality iron from 7 to 12
[*] Greatly increased item drop rates from Wilders that appear at night
[*] Increased experience gained from Wilders that appear at night
[*] Added a "Repair All" button in the equipped item info window
[*] Added an option in game settings under Key/Button Configuration to set a key for quickly switching to specific formations
[/list]

notes.title: Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse - PC version features
notes.content:
Differences and features between the mobile and PC versions of "Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse".

< PC Version Features >
- All microtransaction content removed
- All advertisement content removed
- Overall balance adjustments (combat, drop rates, items, etc.)
- Paid content (skins, etc.) made obtainable in-game

< Quality Improvements >
- Increased texture resolution for characters, backgrounds, and icons
- Sound quality enhanced
- Complete renewal of the forest area background
- Night scenes improved + Added “Wilder” eye glow effect
- Enhanced heat sound quality (+ Added iron heating sound)
- Improved weather effects quality
- Added animations to background objects (reflects changes according to weather)
- Added special UI effects (item crafting, base camp upgrades, etc.)
- Added hidden monster display effects in the background

< New Content >
- Added full sprint function
- Added auto-use function for recovery items
- Added operation board (standby squad members gather materials)
- Added 20 large buildings
- Added 50+ bunkers
- Added wandering merchants
- Added quality enhancement system
- Added 3 new boss-level monsters (Void, Pillager Assault Captain, Enhanced Drone)
- Added 20+ rare reward areas
- Added basic outfits
- Added new boss monster patterns
- Added illustrations for event scenes
- Added final battle scenes
- Enhanced map information (added wandering merchants, wilder pit locations)
- Added cooking and crafting for recovery items (added drinks and food)
- Added gamepad support
- Added skin duplication system
- Added Steam achievements
- Added monologues after all indoor monsters are eliminated

< System Renewal >
- Changed targeting method (automatic -> manual control)
- Renewed EB and Bigfoot skin system (changed to research system by obtaining remains instead of skins)
- Renewed warehouse expansion system (expanded by obtaining hard case remains)
- Changed resurrection system (now consumes a defibrillator)
- Renewed skill reset system (now resettable at the training center)
- Renewed fishing system
- Updated item acquisition system (added item acquisition messages; companions can now collect items)
- Added full map images
- Modified firing mode options for each gun
- Changed Hunter appearance conditions and method
- Made all skins obtainable
- Replaced Citadel Attack Helicopter
- Now purchasable with Emergency Transport Service gems
- Changed so that squad members can shoot when the squad leader collects
